description.narrative: Cumulative number of SAIs having HRpolicies with gender, diversity and inclusion focus developed

comment.narrative: SAI Eritrea has developed a new specific Gender strategy and policy. SAI Somalia has included gender strategies in the new HRpolicy. SAI Zimbabwe has worked on a gender strategy and policy. For the other countries this has not been prioritized for country level support in 2022. AFROSAIE and CREFIAF have ongoing regional support for Gender policies and this is expected to lead to more progress in 2023.Source PAPAPP programme report 2022.
